registry_ts: buildExtension now records a `RoleCandidate` per declared role (`contributes.roles[i]`, name, absolute persona, and this plane's LOCAL decision) and keeps `roles`/`contributions.roles`/`resolvedRoots.roles` in sync with it.

Local (statically decidable) refusals, reproduced verbatim from the roster: a base-roster NAME collision (the base wins; the name key is case/space/hyphen/underscore-insensitive), a base-roster ID collision (`ext-<extension>-<slug>`), an unreadable OR EMPTY persona (the old existsSync-only test accepted a zero-byte persona the roster refuses), and a missing root.

New exported `annotateRoleSurfaces(entries)`, called from `MpdExtensionRegistry.view()`, re-derives the whole-view decision the way the roster does: base names first, then each extension in view order claims what it exposes, first wins; a later collision becomes a `refused:` error instead of a silently listed role. Idempotent by construction (its notes are filtered by their `refused:` prefix before re-adding), so per-call views cannot accumulate duplicates while validation and bridge errors are preserved.

A descriptor-disabled extension claims nothing and exposes no roles (the roster skips disabled views); it says so once via `pending contributes.roles: not exposed: this extension is disabled (enabled=false), ...` instead of listing the roles as usable.
`roles`/`contributions.roles` now mean 'what the roster currently exposes'; `resolvedRoots.roles` keeps meaning 'which persona assets resolved'.

The mirrored rules are `roleNameKey` / `extensionRoleId` (exported) and the base data comes from `mpd-roles-plugin/src/roles.data` (a pure data module). Importing the roster's MODULE was rejected deliberately: it drags the cordis adapter into this registry, which the dev CLI (`scripts/mpd-ext.mjs validate`) imports with no host at all.
core_test_ts: Replaced the test that asserted the wrong text (`mcp and roles are declared, recorded as pending, and not implemented in this task`) with `mcp is pending until the bridge connects it, while roles are NEVER pending (t14/F3)`.

Added nine t14 cases: F3 live-roles reporting on both tools (including a negative assertion on the removed sentence), base-name collision in BOTH paths (build-time/CLI validate and the view), unreadable + EMPTY persona, cross-extension collision naming the holder, disabled-extension reporting, refusal-note idempotency, case/separator-insensitive base-name collision, and a PARITY test that calls the roster's own `extensionRoles()` and requires both the exposed names and every refusal reason to match.
The t14 cases deliberately import no symbol this repair introduces, so the same file runs against the pre-fix behaviour and measures RED (see before_tests).

residuals_and_findings.subject: config-disabled extensions and the whole-view claim map
residuals_and_findings.detail: `view()` cannot see `extensions.disable[]` (the EFFECTIVE enabled state is resolved by the caller, `toView` -> `effectiveEnabled`, outside registry.ts). A descriptor-disabled extension claims nothing, exactly like the roster; a CONFIG-disabled one is still treated as claiming, so a later extension's same-named role is reported refused while the roster would expose it. Both tools already report `enabled: false`; closing the gap needs the caller's config (documented in the code comment on annotateRoleSurfaces).

residuals_and_findings.kind: finding (out of this task's fix scope)
residuals_and_findings.subject: the ROSTER exposes a PROJECT-plane extension's role
residuals_and_findings.detail: MEASURED: with `<workspace>/.mpd/extensions/proj-ext` declaring a role with a readable persona, mpd_ext_list/mpd_ext_show correctly report the contract rejection and expose nothing, while the roster's extensionRoles() EXPOSES 'Project Role'. The resolver checks `enabled`, the declared roles and the persona, but never the plane. Fix belongs in packages/mpd-roles-plugin/src/index.ts (skip `view.plane === 'project'`, mirroring the existing `enabled === false` guard), which t14 must not edit.

residuals_and_findings.subject: AGENTS.md wording
residuals_and_findings.detail: AGENTS.md §4 gained the Extension CLI gate and §12 already documents the project-plane rejection as expected; if the roster leak above is fixed, that §12 row needs re-reading. AGENTS.md was out of this task's scope and was not touched.
